verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official open-source CLI (github.com/ramp-public/ramp-cli), installable via curl or brew. It is explicitly built for agents: `--agent` JSON output (the default when piped), `--no-input` for CI, browserless client-credentials agent login, human/agent profiles, and broad resource coverage. The AI Agents guide and llms.txt also position it as the channel for coding agents and scripted workflows, and it ships packaged skills such as agentic-purchase. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI installs and runs as documented (the probe only confirms the repo is referenced).
